implementation_findings.finding: validate checks JSON fields, IDs, quote substring and exact offsets only. It does not check semantic support or question completeness. D01/D04 pass despite incorrect/incomplete answer. This limitation is honestly stated by module docstring; it must not be reported as hallucination prevention.

Dense question threshold learns answerability from max similarity, not presence of gold evidence. D01 exactly meets threshold using library passages and gets irrelevant context. Calibration F1=1 does not measure factual retrieval coverage.

Enum candidates include Markdown headings and isolated wrapped lines, so exact citations can be fragments that omit operative clauses. D04 quote ends before created:false, other citations are unrelated. Structural enum does not establish entailment.
No host check that all queried aspects are covered. D04 misses conflict and still status answered.
Loaded retrieval config records index_generation but retrieve never checks it against current index. Rebuilt or swapped index can reuse calibrated thresholds silently.

Context pruning uses profile context only, whereas Model.complete enforces min(profile context, runtime n_ctx); if runtime capacity is smaller than profile, Agent fails context_limit rather than pruning enough.

RAG dialogue is used as untrusted_prior_dialogue but retrieval runs only on latest literal question. Follow-up questions referring to prior context may retrieve unrelated sources; not demonstrated by this dev set.
